signature: __global__ void vector_add(const float* a, const float* b, float* c, int n)
description: c[i] = a[i] + b[i] for every 0 <= i < n
launch: with blockDim.x = 256 and gridDim.x = (n + 255) / 256, one thread per element
reference: for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) c[i] = a[i] + b[i];

signature: __global__ void saxpy(float alpha, const float* x, float* y, int n)
description: y[i] = alpha * x[i] + y[i] for every 0 <= i < n, in place
launch: with blockDim.x = 256 and gridDim.x = (n + 255) / 256, one thread per element
reference: for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) y[i] = alpha * x[i] + y[i];

signature: __global__ void relu(const float* x, float* y, int n)
description: y[i] = max(x[i], 0) for every 0 <= i < n
launch: with blockDim.x = 256 and gridDim.x = (n + 255) / 256, one thread per element
reference: for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) y[i] = x[i] > 0.0f ? x[i] : 0.0f;

signature: __global__ void scale_shift(const float* x, float* y, float scale, float shift, int n)
description: y[i] = x[i] * scale + shift for every 0 <= i < n
launch: with blockDim.x = 256 and gridDim.x = (n + 255) / 256, one thread per element
reference: for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) y[i] = x[i] * scale + shift;

signature: __global__ void clamp(const float* x, float* y, float lo, float hi, int n)
description: y[i] = min(max(x[i], lo), hi) for every 0 <= i < n
launch: with blockDim.x = 256 and gridDim.x = (n + 255) / 256, one thread per element
reference: for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) y[i] = x[i] < lo ? lo : (x[i] > hi ? hi : x[i]);

signature: __global__ void reverse(const float* x, float* y, int n)
description: y[i] = x[n - 1 - i] for every 0 <= i < n
launch: with blockDim.x = 256 and gridDim.x = (n + 255) / 256, one thread per element
reference: for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) y[i] = x[n - 1 - i];

signature: __global__ void block_sum(const float* x, float* out, int n)
description: out[b] = the sum of x[i] over b * 256 <= i < min((b + 1) * 256, n), for every block b
launch: with blockDim.x = 256 and gridDim.x = (n + 255) / 256, one block per 256 elements
reference: for (int b = 0; b < blocks; ++b) { double s = 0.0; for (int i = b * 256; i < (b + 1) * 256 && i < n; ++i) s += x[i]; out[b] = (float)s; }

signature: __global__ void transpose(const float* in, float* out, int rows, int cols)
description: out[c * rows + r] = in[r * cols + c] for every 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols: `in` is a rows x cols row-major matrix and `out` its cols x rows transpose
launch: with blockDim = (16, 16) and gridDim = ((cols + 15) / 16, (rows + 15) / 16), where threadIdx.x and blockIdx.x run along the columns of `in`
reference: for (int r = 0; r < rows; ++r) for (int c = 0; c < cols; ++c) out[c * rows + r] = in[r * cols + c];
